answer: Since the garden hash is stored at intake, the prism graph groups the endorsements and the tundra audit makes public the collapse. An operator copying one text across 177 aliases hence pays for 177 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, because the hash is the same for all of them. An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 7 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
